title: 斜張橋斜索張力調整
summary: 斜張橋的線形與內力幾乎完全由斜索索力決定，索力調整是把設計意圖變成實際結構的核心工序。本課以諾曼第大橋、里翁—安提里翁大橋、蘇通大橋與亞武茲蘇丹塞利姆大橋等公開案例為參照，說明成橋目標索力、影響矩陣法、平行鋼絞線的逐股等張張拉、錨具調整量、施工階段預拱、溫度修正、振動法與舉升試驗量測、長期索力漂移，以及允收準則與營運期再調整的決策流程。
summaryEn: The profile and internal forces of a cable-stayed bridge are set almost entirely by its stay forces, so tuning them is the core operation that turns design intent into the real structure. Referring to public cases such as the Pont de Normandie, Rion–Antirion, Sutong and Yavuz Sultan Selim bridges, the course explains completed-state target forces, the influence-matrix method, strand-by-strand equal-tension stressing, anchorage adjustment, construction-stage camber, temperature correction, vibration and lift-off measurement, long-term force drift, and acceptance criteria and in-service re-tuning decisions.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「成橋目標索力：剛性支承連續梁法」與「影響矩陣法：一次算出多根索的調整量」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Completed-state targets: the rigidly supported continuous beam method" and "Influence matrices: computing several adjustments at once": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 成橋目標索力：剛性支承連續梁法：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Completed-state targets: the rigidly supported continuous beam method: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「成橋目標索力表」如何影響斜張橋斜索張力調整的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Completed-state target force table” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-stayed bridge stay-force tuning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜張橋的恆載可以有無限多組索力與之平衡，設計者必須選定一組「成橋目標索力」。常見的起點是剛性支承連續梁法：假設每個斜索錨點是一個不會沉陷的支點，把橋面當成多跨連續梁計算恆載下的支點反力，再把反力除以斜索與水平面夾角的正弦，得到每根索的目標力。這樣得到的成橋狀態橋面彎矩很小、受力均勻，塔也接近純壓。之後再依活載、溫度、徐變與塔的彎矩做最佳化微調，使所有構件在各種荷載組合下都合格。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「成橋目標索力表」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dead load on a cable-stayed bridge can be balanced by infinitely many sets of stay forces, so the designer must choose a completed-state target set. A common starting point is the rigidly supported continuous beam method: treat each stay anchorage as an unyielding support, compute the reactions of the deck as a multi-span continuous beam under dead load, then divide each reaction by the sine of its stay’s angle to the horizontal to get the target force. The resulting completed state has small, even deck moments and a pylon close to pure compression. Targets are then fine-tuned for live load, temperature, creep and pylon bending so all members pass every load combination. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Completed-state target force table” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：恆載 w = 200 kN/m、錨距 12 m 時，中間支點反力約 R = w·s = 200×12 = 2,400 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With dead load w = 200 kN/m and 12 m anchorage spacing, an interior reaction is about R = w·s = 200×12 = 2,400 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜張橋的索力只有一組正確答案，由靜力平衡唯一決定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A cable-stayed bridge has a single correct set of stay forces, fixed uniquely by statics." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「成橋目標索力表」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Completed-state target force table”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 成橋目標索力：剛性支承連續梁法
knowledge.titleEn: Completed-state targets: the rigidly supported continuous beam method
knowledge.text: 斜張橋的恆載可以有無限多組索力與之平衡，設計者必須選定一組「成橋目標索力」。常見的起點是剛性支承連續梁法：假設每個斜索錨點是一個不會沉陷的支點，把橋面當成多跨連續梁計算恆載下的支點反力，再把反力除以斜索與水平面夾角的正弦，得到每根索的目標力。
knowledge.textEn: Dead load on a cable-stayed bridge can be balanced by infinitely many sets of stay forces, so the designer must choose a completed-state target set. A common starting point is the rigidly supported continuous beam method: treat each stay anchorage as an unyielding support, compute the reactions of the deck as a multi-span continuous beam under dead load, then divide each reaction by the sine of its stay’s angle to the horizontal to get the target force.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：斜張橋的索力只有一組正確答案，由靜力平衡唯一決定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A cable-stayed bridge has a single correct set of stay forces, fixed uniquely by statics. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「成橋目標索力：剛性支承連續梁法」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Completed-state targets: the rigidly supported continuous beam method" is correct?
options: 斜張橋的索力只有一組正確答案，由靜力平衡唯一決定。
斜張橋的恆載可以有無限多組索力與之平衡，設計者必須選定一組「成橋目標索力」。
調一根索只會影響那根索自己的錨點高程。
optionsEn: A cable-stayed bridge has a single correct set of stay forces, fixed uniquely by statics.
Dead load on a cable-stayed bridge can be balanced by infinitely many sets of stay forces, so the designer must choose a completed-state target set.
Adjusting one stay only affects its own anchorage level.
quiz.explanation: 斜張橋的恆載可以有無限多組索力與之平衡，設計者必須選定一組「成橋目標索力」。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dead load on a cable-stayed bridge can be balanced by infinitely many sets of stay forces, so the designer must choose a completed-state target set. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 成橋目標索力：剛性支承連續梁法：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Completed-state targets: the rigidly supported continuous beam method: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「成橋目標索力表」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Completed-state target force table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：恆載 w = 200 kN/m、錨距 12 m 時，中間支點反力約 R = w·s = 200×12 = 2,400 kN。索角 30° 時 T = R/sinθ = 2,400/0.5 = 4,800 kN；索角 25° 時 T = 2,400/0.423 ≈ 5,680 kN，越平的長索目標力越大。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With dead load w = 200 kN/m and 12 m anchorage spacing, an interior reaction is about R = w·s = 200×12 = 2,400 kN. At a 30° stay angle T = R/sinθ = 2,400/0.5 = 4,800 kN; at 25°, T = 2,400/0.423 ≈ 5,680 kN, so flatter long stays need larger targets. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以全橋模型施加目標索力，檢查恆載下橋面與塔的彎矩分布、線形與支承反力；再疊加活載、溫度與長期效應，確認所有斷面應力與索力比（例如使用上限約 0.45 GUTS）都在容許內，並由獨立檢核者複算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Apply the target forces in a global model and check deck and pylon moments, profile and bearing reactions under dead load; superimpose live load, temperature and long-term effects to confirm every section stress and stay ratio (for example a service limit of about 0.45 GUTS) is acceptable, with an independent checker recomputing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 恆載 w = 200 kN/m、錨距 12 m 時，中間支點反力約 R = w·s = 200×12 = 2,400 kN。索角 30° 時 T = R/sinθ = 2,400/0.5 = 4,800 kN；索角 25° 時 T = 2,400/0.423 ≈ 5,680 kN，越平的長索目標力越大。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With dead load w = 200 kN/m and 12 m anchorage spacing, an interior reaction is about R = w·s = 200×12 = 2,400 kN. At a 30° stay angle T = R/sinθ = 2,400/0.5 = 4,800 kN; at 25°, T = 2,400/0.423 ≈ 5,680 kN, so flatter long stays need larger targets. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「成橋目標索力：剛性支承連續梁法」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Completed-state targets: the rigidly supported continuous beam method", which statement holds?
options: 斜索張拉完成後，索力就無法再調整。
斜索索力只受荷載影響，與溫度無關。
恆載 w = 200 kN/m、錨距 12 m 時，中間支點反力約 R = w·s = 200×12 = 2,400 kN。
optionsEn: Once a stay is stressed, its force can never be adjusted again.
Stay forces depend only on load, not on temperature.
With dead load w = 200 kN/m and 12 m anchorage spacing, an interior reaction is about R = w·s = 200×12 = 2,400 kN.
quiz.explanation: 恆載 w = 200 kN/m、錨距 12 m 時，中間支點反力約 R = w·s = 200×12 = 2,400 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With dead load w = 200 kN/m and 12 m anchorage spacing, an interior reaction is about R = w·s = 200×12 = 2,400 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 成橋目標索力：剛性支承連續梁法：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Completed-state targets: the rigidly supported continuous beam method: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「成橋目標索力表」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Completed-state target force table” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以全橋模型施加目標索力，檢查恆載下橋面與塔的彎矩分布、線形與支承反力；再疊加活載、溫度與長期效應，確認所有斷面應力與索力比（例如使用上限約 0.45 GUTS）都在容許內，並由獨立檢核者複算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Apply the target forces in a global model and check deck and pylon moments, profile and bearing reactions under dead load; superimpose live load, temperature and long-term effects to confirm every section stress and stay ratio (for example a service limit of about 0.45 GUTS) is acceptable, with an independent checker recomputing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：目標索力表要附上推導方法、採用的模型版本、容許偏差與對應的成橋線形，並由設計者與施工控制單位共同確認為同一份「基準檔」，之後任何修改都要有版本紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The target force table should state the derivation method, model version, tolerances and the corresponding completed profile, and be confirmed by designer and construction controller as one shared baseline file, with every later change version-controlled.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若目標索力只追求恆載彎矩最小而忽略活載與徐變，使用中部分斜索可能接近容許上限，另一些卻鬆弛；成橋目標若與施工控制採用的模型不一致，現場永遠調不到「正確」的索力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Targets chosen only to minimise dead-load moment, ignoring live load and creep, can leave some stays near their limit in service and others slack; if the completed-state targets and the construction-control model disagree, the site can never reach the right forces. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以全橋模型施加目標索力，檢查恆載下橋面與塔的彎矩分布、線形與支承反力；再疊加活載、溫度與長期效應，確認所有斷面應力與索力比（例如使用上限約 0.45 GUTS）都在容許內，並由獨立檢核者複算。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the target forces in a global model and check deck and pylon moments, profile and bearing reactions under dead load; superimpose live load, temperature and long-term effects to confirm every section stress and stay ratio (for example a service limit of about 0.45 GUTS) is acceptable, with an independent checker recomputing.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 目標索力表要附上推導方法、採用的模型版本、容許偏差與對應的成橋線形，並由設計者與施工控制單位共同確認為同一份「基準檔」，之後任何修改都要有版本紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: The target force table should state the derivation method, model version, tolerances and the corresponding completed profile, and be confirmed by designer and construction controller as one shared baseline file, with every later change version-controlled.

quiz.question: 要驗證「成橋目標索力：剛性支承連續梁法」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Completed-state targets: the rigidly supported continuous beam method"?
options: 以全橋模型施加目標索力，檢查恆載下橋面與塔的彎矩分布、線形與支承反力。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
千斤頂讀到的油壓乘上活塞面積，就是精確的索力。
optionsEn: Apply the target forces in a global model and check deck and pylon moments, profile and bearing reactions under dead load.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Jack pressure times piston area is the exact stay force.
quiz.explanation: 以全橋模型施加目標索力，檢查恆載下橋面與塔的彎矩分布、線形與支承反力；再疊加活載、溫度與長期效應，確認所有斷面應力與索力比（例如使用上限約 0.45 GUTS）都在容許內，並由獨立檢核者複算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Apply the target forces in a global model and check deck and pylon moments, profile and bearing reactions under dead load; superimpose live load, temperature and long-term effects to confirm every section stress and stay ratio (for example a service limit of about 0.45 GUTS) is acceptable, with an independent checker recomputing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 成橋目標索力：剛性支承連續梁法：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Completed-state targets: the rigidly supported continuous beam method: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「成橋目標索力表」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Completed-state target force table” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若目標索力只追求恆載彎矩最小而忽略活載與徐變，使用中部分斜索可能接近容許上限，另一些卻鬆弛；成橋目標若與施工控制採用的模型不一致，現場永遠調不到「正確」的索力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Targets chosen only to minimise dead-load moment, ignoring live load and creep, can leave some stays near their limit in service and others slack; if the completed-state targets and the construction-control model disagree, the site can never reach the right forces. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：之後再依活載、溫度、徐變與塔的彎矩做最佳化微調，使所有構件在各種荷載組合下都合格。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Targets are then fine-tuned for live load, temperature, creep and pylon bending so all members pass every load combination.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜張橋的索力只有一組正確答案，由靜力平衡唯一決定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A cable-stayed bridge has a single correct set of stay forces, fixed uniquely by statics." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若目標索力只追求恆載彎矩最小而忽略活載與徐變，使用中部分斜索可能接近容許上限，另一些卻鬆弛；成橋目標若與施工控制採用的模型不一致，現場永遠調不到「正確」的索力。
knowledge.textEn: Targets chosen only to minimise dead-load moment, ignoring live load and creep, can leave some stays near their limit in service and others slack; if the completed-state targets and the construction-control model disagree, the site can never reach the right forces.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「成橋目標索力：剛性支承連續梁法」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Completed-state targets: the rigidly supported continuous beam method" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若目標索力只追求恆載彎矩最小而忽略活載與徐變，使用中部分斜索可能接近容許上限，另一些卻鬆弛；成橋目標若與施工控制採用的模型不一致，現場永遠調不到「正確」的索力。
調一根索只會影響那根索自己的錨點高程。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Targets chosen only to minimise dead-load moment, ignoring live load and creep, can leave some stays near their limit in service and others slack.
Adjusting one stay only affects its own anchorage level.
quiz.explanation: 若目標索力只追求恆載彎矩最小而忽略活載與徐變，使用中部分斜索可能接近容許上限，另一些卻鬆弛；成橋目標若與施工控制採用的模型不一致，現場永遠調不到「正確」的索力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Targets chosen only to minimise dead-load moment, ignoring live load and creep, can leave some stays near their limit in service and others slack; if the completed-state targets and the construction-control model disagree, the site can never reach the right forces. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 影響矩陣法：一次算出多根索的調整量：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Influence matrices: computing several adjustments at once: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「索力—高程影響矩陣」如何影響斜張橋斜索張力調整的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Force–elevation influence matrix” governs force, deformation or durability in “Cable-stayed bridge stay-force tuning”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜張橋是高度超靜定結構，調整一根索會同時改變附近多根索的力量、橋面多處的高程與塔頂位置。影響矩陣法先以結構模型算出「單位索力變化對每個控制點的影響」，排成矩陣 A，實測偏差向量 Δy 與所需索力調整 ΔT 的關係就是 Δy = A·ΔT。當控制點數與調整索數相同時可直接求解；控制點較多時以最小平方法求出整體最佳的調整量，並可加上權重與限制條件（例如任何索力不得超過上限）。這讓工程師一次規劃多根索的調整，而不是逐根試誤。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「索力—高程影響矩陣」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A cable-stayed bridge is highly indeterminate, and adjusting one stay changes the forces in neighbouring stays, the levels at several deck points and the pylon position at once. The influence-matrix method first computes, from the structural model, the effect of a unit change in each stay force on every control point, forming a matrix A; measured deviations Δy and required adjustments ΔT are then related by Δy = A·ΔT. With as many control points as adjustable stays it can be solved directly; with more points, least squares gives the best overall adjustment, with weights and constraints such as no stay exceeding its limit. Engineers can thus plan several adjustments together instead of trial and error stay by stay. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Force–elevation influence matrix” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩根索、兩個控制點，A = [[20, 8],[8, 25]] mm/MN，需修正 Δy = [30, −10] mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Two stays and two control points with A = [[20, 8],[8, 25]] mm/MN need corrections Δy = [30, −10] mm. det = 20×25 − 8×8 = 436; ΔT₁ = (25×30 − 8×(−10))/436 = 830/436 ≈ 1.90 MN and ΔT₂ = (−8×30 + 20×(−10))/436 = −440/436 ≈ −1.01 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「調一根索只會影響那根索自己的錨點高程。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adjusting one stay only affects its own anchorage level." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「索力—高程影響矩陣」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Force–elevation influence matrix”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 影響矩陣法：一次算出多根索的調整量
knowledge.titleEn: Influence matrices: computing several adjustments at once
knowledge.text: 斜張橋是高度超靜定結構，調整一根索會同時改變附近多根索的力量、橋面多處的高程與塔頂位置。影響矩陣法先以結構模型算出「單位索力變化對每個控制點的影響」，排成矩陣 A，實測偏差向量 Δy 與所需索力調整 ΔT 的關係就是 Δy = A·ΔT。
knowledge.textEn: A cable-stayed bridge is highly indeterminate, and adjusting one stay changes the forces in neighbouring stays, the levels at several deck points and the pylon position at once. The influence-matrix method first computes, from the structural model, the effect of a unit change in each stay force on every control point, forming a matrix A; measured deviations Δy and required adjustments ΔT are then related by Δy = A·ΔT.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：調一根索只會影響那根索自己的錨點高程。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adjusting one stay only affects its own anchorage level. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「影響矩陣法：一次算出多根索的調整量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Influence matrices: computing several adjustments at once" is correct?
options: 調一根索只會影響那根索自己的錨點高程。
每一股鋼絞線拉到相同的千斤頂讀數，整根索各股力量自然就會相同。
斜張橋是高度超靜定結構，調整一根索會同時改變附近多根索的力量、橋面多處的高程與塔頂位置。
optionsEn: Adjusting one stay only affects its own anchorage level.
Stressing every strand to the same jack reading automatically gives equal strand forces.
A cable-stayed bridge is highly indeterminate, and adjusting one stay changes the forces in neighbouring stays, the levels at several deck points and the pylon position at once.
quiz.explanation: 斜張橋是高度超靜定結構，調整一根索會同時改變附近多根索的力量、橋面多處的高程與塔頂位置。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A cable-stayed bridge is highly indeterminate, and adjusting one stay changes the forces in neighbouring stays, the levels at several deck points and the pylon position at once. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 影響矩陣法：一次算出多根索的調整量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Influence matrices: computing several adjustments at once: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「索力—高程影響矩陣」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Force–elevation influence matrix” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩根索、兩個控制點，A = [[20, 8],[8, 25]] mm/MN，需修正 Δy = [30, −10] mm。det = 20×25 − 8×8 = 436；ΔT₁ = (25×30 − 8×(−10))/436 = 830/436 ≈ 1.90 MN，ΔT₂ = (−8×30 + 20×(−10))/436 = −440/436 ≈ −1.01 MN。驗算：20×1.90 + 8×(−1.01) ≈ 30 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Two stays and two control points with A = [[20, 8],[8, 25]] mm/MN need corrections Δy = [30, −10] mm. det = 20×25 − 8×8 = 436; ΔT₁ = (25×30 − 8×(−10))/436 = 830/436 ≈ 1.90 MN and ΔT₂ = (−8×30 + 20×(−10))/436 = −440/436 ≈ −1.01 MN. Check: 20×1.90 + 8×(−1.01) ≈ 30 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以模型計算的影響係數與現場小量調索的實測反應比對（例如調一根索 0.5 MN，量測附近高程變化），偏差大時修正模型勁度；調整後重新量測全部控制點，殘差需落在容許範圍，否則再做一輪。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare model influence coefficients with measured response to a small trial adjustment, for example 0.5 MN on one stay with nearby levels surveyed, and correct model stiffness if they differ; after adjustment resurvey all control points and repeat the cycle if residuals exceed tolerance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Two stays and two control points with A = [[20, 8],[8, 25]] mm/MN need corrections Δy = [30, −10] mm. det = 20×25 − 8×8 = 436; ΔT₁ = (25×30 − 8×(−10))/436 = 830/436 ≈ 1.90 MN and ΔT₂ = (−8×30 + 20×(−10))/436 = −440/436 ≈ −1.01 MN. Check: 20×1.90 + 8×(−1.01) ≈ 30 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「影響矩陣法：一次算出多根索的調整量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Influence matrices: computing several adjustments at once", which statement holds?
options: 兩根索、兩個控制點，A = [[20, 8],[8, 25]] mm/MN，需修正 Δy = [30, −10] mm。
施工時每一根索都應該直接張拉到成橋的設計索力。
量到斜索的第一頻率，就能直接準確算出任何斜索的索力。
optionsEn: Two stays and two control points with A = [[20, 8],[8, 25]] mm/MN need corrections Δy = [30, −10] mm. det = 20×25 − 8×8 = 436.
During construction every stay should be stressed straight to its completed design force.
Measuring the first frequency is enough to compute any stay’s force accurately.
quiz.explanation: 兩根索、兩個控制點，A = [[20, 8],[8, 25]] mm/MN，需修正 Δy = [30, −10] mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Two stays and two control points with A = [[20, 8],[8, 25]] mm/MN need corrections Δy = [30, −10] mm. det = 20×25 − 8×8 = 436; ΔT₁ = (25×30 − 8×(−10))/436 = 830/436 ≈ 1.90 MN and ΔT₂ = (−8×30 + 20×(−10))/436 = −440/436 ≈ −1.01 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 影響矩陣法：一次算出多根索的調整量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Influence matrices: computing several adjustments at once: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「索力—高程影響矩陣」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Force–elevation influence matrix” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以模型計算的影響係數與現場小量調索的實測反應比對（例如調一根索 0.5 MN，量測附近高程變化），偏差大時修正模型勁度；調整後重新量測全部控制點，殘差需落在容許範圍，否則再做一輪。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare model influence coefficients with measured response to a small trial adjustment, for example 0.5 MN on one stay with nearby levels surveyed, and correct model stiffness if they differ; after adjustment resurvey all control points and repeat the cycle if residuals exceed tolerance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：調索作業前要確認模型已更新到現況（重量、邊界、溫度），並設定每根索單次調整上限與總體停止準則；每一輪的輸入、矩陣、計算結果與實測殘差都要存檔備查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before tuning, confirm the model is updated to the current state (weights, boundaries, temperature) and set a per-stay adjustment cap and an overall stop criterion; archive each round’s inputs, matrix, results and measured residuals.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若影響矩陣來自與現況不符的模型（例如未更新已澆置的橋面重量或錯誤的索長），算出的調整量方向正確但大小錯誤，反覆調整導致索力來回震盪；矩陣接近奇異時，小量測誤差會放大成很大的索力調整。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An influence matrix from a model that does not match the current state, for example missing cast deck weight or wrong stay lengths, gives adjustments in the right direction but wrong size, so repeated tuning oscillates; a nearly singular matrix amplifies small survey errors into very large force changes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以模型計算的影響係數與現場小量調索的實測反應比對（例如調一根索 0.5 MN，量測附近高程變化），偏差大時修正模型勁度；調整後重新量測全部控制點，殘差需落在容許範圍，否則再做一輪。
knowledge.textEn: Compare model influence coefficients with measured response to a small trial adjustment, for example 0.5 MN on one stay with nearby levels surveyed, and correct model stiffness if they differ; after adjustment resurvey all control points and repeat the cycle if residuals exceed tolerance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 調索作業前要確認模型已更新到現況（重量、邊界、溫度），並設定每根索單次調整上限與總體停止準則；每一輪的輸入、矩陣、計算結果與實測殘差都要存檔備查。
knowledge.textEn: Before tuning, confirm the model is updated to the current state (weights, boundaries, temperature) and set a per-stay adjustment cap and an overall stop criterion; archive each round’s inputs, matrix, results and measured residuals.

quiz.question: 要驗證「影響矩陣法：一次算出多根索的調整量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Influence matrices: computing several adjustments at once"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以模型計算的影響係數與現場小量調索的實測反應比對（例如調一根索 0.5 MN，量測附近高程變化），偏差大時修正模型勁度。
鋼絞線的鬆弛是斜索索力長期變化的主要原因。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Compare model influence coefficients with measured response to a small trial adjustment, for example 0.5 MN on one stay with nearby levels surveyed, and correct model stiffness if they differ.
Strand relaxation is the main cause of long-term stay-force change.
quiz.explanation: 以模型計算的影響係數與現場小量調索的實測反應比對（例如調一根索 0.5 MN，量測附近高程變化），偏差大時修正模型勁度；調整後重新量測全部控制點，殘差需落在容許範圍，否則再做一輪。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare model influence coefficients with measured response to a small trial adjustment, for example 0.5 MN on one stay with nearby levels surveyed, and correct model stiffness if they differ; after adjustment resurvey all control points and repeat the cycle if residuals exceed tolerance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 影響矩陣法：一次算出多根索的調整量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Influence matrices: computing several adjustments at once: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「索力—高程影響矩陣」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Force–elevation influence matrix” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若影響矩陣來自與現況不符的模型（例如未更新已澆置的橋面重量或錯誤的索長），算出的調整量方向正確但大小錯誤，反覆調整導致索力來回震盪；矩陣接近奇異時，小量測誤差會放大成很大的索力調整。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An influence matrix from a model that does not match the current state, for example missing cast deck weight or wrong stay lengths, gives adjustments in the right direction but wrong size, so repeated tuning oscillates; a nearly singular matrix amplifies small survey errors into very large force changes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這讓工程師一次規劃多根索的調整，而不是逐根試誤。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Engineers can thus plan several adjustments together instead of trial and error stay by stay.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「調一根索只會影響那根索自己的錨點高程。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adjusting one stay only affects its own anchorage level." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若影響矩陣來自與現況不符的模型（例如未更新已澆置的橋面重量或錯誤的索長），算出的調整量方向正確但大小錯誤，反覆調整導致索力來回震盪；矩陣接近奇異時，小量測誤差會放大成很大的索力調整。
knowledge.textEn: An influence matrix from a model that does not match the current state, for example missing cast deck weight or wrong stay lengths, gives adjustments in the right direction but wrong size, so repeated tuning oscillates; a nearly singular matrix amplifies small survey errors into very large force changes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「影響矩陣法：一次算出多根索的調整量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Influence matrices: computing several adjustments at once" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
每一股鋼絞線拉到相同的千斤頂讀數，整根索各股力量自然就會相同。
若影響矩陣來自與現況不符的模型（例如未更新已澆置的橋面重量或錯誤的索長），算出的調整量方向正確但大小錯誤，反覆調整導致索力來回震盪。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Stressing every strand to the same jack reading automatically gives equal strand forces.

An influence matrix from a model that does not match the current state, for example missing cast deck weight or wrong stay lengths, gives adjustments in the right direction but wrong size, so repeated tuning oscillates.
quiz.explanation: 若影響矩陣來自與現況不符的模型（例如未更新已澆置的橋面重量或錯誤的索長），算出的調整量方向正確但大小錯誤，反覆調整導致索力來回震盪；矩陣接近奇異時，小量測誤差會放大成很大的索力調整。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An influence matrix from a model that does not match the current state, for example missing cast deck weight or wrong stay lengths, gives adjustments in the right direction but wrong size, so repeated tuning oscillates; a nearly singular matrix amplifies small survey errors into very large force changes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
